description: Java class MapStack extending MapContext, providing stack-based map management with methods for creating, copying, and managing context maps, including special handling for 'context' key and sharing maps between parent and child stacks.

classes.name: MapStack
classes.description: A stack-based map class extending MapContext, supporting context management with methods for creation, copying, and context sharing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new MapStack instance, optionally initialized with a base map or copying from another MapStack.

methods.name: standAloneStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack sharing the same maps as the current one, for parent-child context sharing.

methods.name: standAloneChildStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack with the same maps as current, but with a new map pushed on top, for nested context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides Map get method; returns self if key is 'context'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method; retrieves value with locale consideration; returns self if name is 'context'.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Overrides Map put method; logs warning if key is 'context' and value is not self.
